plainText:
Yoshimasa Hosoya (Japanese: 細谷佳正 Hosoya Yoshimasa) is a Japanese voice actor for .

==Biography==
Hosoya was born on February 10, 1982, in , , and became a voice actor as an adult. He started his career in 2004 and has since become well known for his roles in a number of anime series, commonly sports anime. He also pursued a singing career, formerly being a part of the pop duo MaxBoys alongside fellow voice actor . Hosoya provided his voice for during , most notably voicing motorcyclist Charles. He also voiced Lance in Pokémon Generations. Hosoya was affiliated with the talent agency , but is now freelancing. On April 23, 2017, he went on a temporary hiatus in order to undergo treatment for his throat, returning to work later that year.
